paper_title: Complexity of Preimage Problems for Deterministic Finite Automata
classifications: Theory of computation → Problems, reductions and completeness
statement: The following result may be a bit surprising, in view of that it is the only case where the general problem remains equally hard when the subset size is bounded. We state that the first problem remains PSPACE-complete for all k ≥ 2, although the problem remains open for strongly connected automata.
